children: U.S. waste management firm's Q3 revenue rose 8.2%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 was $1.94, beating analyst expectations
Company authorized $5 bln share repurchase program
Republic Services raises 2026 revenue guidance to $17.425 bln-$17.475 bln
Company lifts 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to $5.550 bln-$5.575 bln
Republic Services now sees 2026 adjusted free cash flow at $2.565 bln-$2.585 bln
PRICING GAINS - Co said core price increases contributed 5.3% to revenue growth, with higher prices in both open market and restricted business segments
ENVIRONMENTAL SOLUTIONS - Co said improved performance in environmental solutions business added 2.1% to revenue growth
ACQUISITIONS - Co said acquisitions contributed 1.3% to revenue growth in Q3
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 14 "strong buy" or "buy", 14 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the environmental services & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Republic Services Inc is $244.00, about 4.5% above its October 28 closing price of $233.40
The stock recently traded at 29 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 28 three months ago
